say:2:1741103002:1.text: All these smiles, all this noise... empty rituals praising something they still call noble, even though it died long ago...
say:2:1741103002:1.source_cn: 用虚假的欢笑来掩盖内心的空虚，用毫无意义的仪式来称颂那...
say:2:1741103002:1.male: All these smiles, all this noise... empty rituals praising something they still call noble, even though it died long ago...
say:2:1741103002:1.female: All these smiles, all this noise... empty rituals praising something they still call noble, even though it died long ago...

say:3:1741103003:1.text: They crowd together because it makes them feel safe. Like ants huddling near a dying fire.
say:3:1741103003:1.source_cn: 这些盲目的人群，多像是一群聚在一起取暖的蝼蚁。
say:3:1741103003:1.male: They crowd together because it makes them feel safe. Like ants huddling near a dying fire.
say:3:1741103003:1.female: They crowd together because it makes them feel safe. Like ants huddling near a dying fire.

say:4:1741103004:1.text: People who spend their whole lives waiting to be saved never learn how to save themselves. Sooner or later, someone stronger comes along and decides their fate for them.
say:4:1741103004:1.source_cn: 无知无觉信仰他人、时刻期待他人拯救、自身却毫无力量的弱...
say:4:1741103004:1.male: People who spend their whole lives waiting to be saved never learn how to save themselves. Sooner or later, someone stronger comes along and decides their fate for them.
say:4:1741103004:1.female: People who spend their whole lives waiting to be saved never learn how to save themselves. Sooner or later, someone stronger comes along and decides their fate for them.

say:5:1741103005:1.text: That's all they'll ever be: pieces on someone else's board. Moved when useful. Thrown away when not.
say:5:1741103005:1.source_cn: 他们只会沦为强者的棋子，成为权力棋盘上的祭品。
say:5:1741103005:1.male: That's all they'll ever be: pieces on someone else's board. Moved when useful. Thrown away when not.
say:5:1741103005:1.female: That's all they'll ever be: pieces on someone else's board. Moved when useful. Thrown away when not.

say:6:1741103006:1.text: And a festival is exactly where people like that gather.
say:6:1741103006:1.source_cn: 而庆典，便是这群可悲之人的聚集地。
say:6:1741103006:1.male: And a festival is exactly where people like that gather.
say:6:1741103006:1.female: And a festival is exactly where people like that gather.

say:7:1741103007:1.text: But you, Magister Merlin, you're the strange one. With power like yours, you could stand above all this. Instead, you're down here with them, wandering around like you're actually having fun...
say:7:1741103007:1.source_cn: 倒是你，梅林阁下。身为拥有改写规则力量的大魔法师，居然...
say:7:1741103007:1.male: But you, Magister Merlin, you're the strange one. With power like yours, you could stand above all this. Instead, you're down here with them, wandering around like you're actually having fun...
say:7:1741103007:1.female: But you, Magister Merlin, you're the strange one. With power like yours, you could stand above all this. Instead, you're down here with them, wandering around like you're actually having fun...

say:8:1741103008:1.text: So which is it? Are you truly carefree enough to enjoy all this, or is that harmless look just the mask you use to hide how much you really understand?
say:8:1741103008:1.source_cn: 我该说你是没心没肺，乐在其中呢？还是说……这正是你大智...
say:8:1741103008:1.male: So which is it? Are you truly carefree enough to enjoy all this, or is that harmless look just the mask you use to hide how much you really understand?
say:8:1741103008:1.female: So which is it? Are you truly carefree enough to enjoy all this, or is that harmless look just the mask you use to hide how much you really understand?
